findings.rule: Scout state for #260 says 'prep.plan.<applicationId>: still removed on application delete and job-draft discard'. Privacy: Delete my data must remove the stored data.
findings.trigger: An install from main saved gap-analysis prep items under prep.plan.analysis-draft-<hash>: AnalysisViewModel on origin/main calls prepPlanRepository.add(ready.draftKey, ...) and draftKey = KeptJobDescription.draftKey. The user upgrades and taps Delete my data. DeleteMyDataUseCase.kt:29 calls discardJobDrafts(kept), which now clears only content reports. The draft key is not an application id, so StoredApplicationCleanup never matches it. The key stays in DataStore until a full account wipe. The plan's caller note ('legacy prep keys are removed on application delete') does not cover draft keys.
findings.title: Delete my data no longer removes the legacy prep plan stored under the job-draft key
findings.proof: DeleteMyDataUseCaseTest.clearsTheReportsOfTheKeptJobDescription: before useCase(), write store.write("prep.plan.${kept.draftKey}", "plan") on a TestMockStateStore injected into DiscardJobDraftsUseCase, then assert store.read(...) is null. This test fails at the head. Fix: inject MockStateStore and call store.remove("prep.plan.${job.draftKey}").

findings.rule: Data export and minimisation: Download my data must export what the app stores, and the app must not keep data it can no longer show, use or export.
findings.trigger: On an install that wrote coverletter.<appId> (cover letter text built from candidate facts) or prep.plan.<appId> before this change, the user taps Download my data. The archive has no cover-letter or prep section, but the text is still in DataStore. It stays there through a same-account sign-out (SignOutCleanerExportFilesTest asserts this) and is removed only when that application is deleted or the account is wiped. session.consent also stays until sign-out. The scout accepted this retention, but the export now differs from what is stored.
findings.title: Legacy cover letters and prep plans stay on device but are no longer exported
findings.proof: Write coverletter.app-1 to the store, run CollectAccountDataUseCase plus the archive writer, and check: the letter text is absent from my-data.json while the store still holds it. Fix: run a one-time purge at app start (store.removeWithPrefix("coverletter."), store.removeWithPrefix("prep.plan."), remove session.consent and session.careerStage). This also closes finding 1.

findings.rule: Constitution IV.1 and checklist item 5: surviving cleanup behaviour keeps a test that fails when it breaks.
findings.trigger: Remove LEGACY_CAREER_STAGE_KEY from signOut() or clear(). Every test still passes, because the career-stage contract tests and StoredSessionRepositoryCareerStageTest are deleted and the replacement tests write only session.consent. A stale session.careerStage value would then stay on the device after sign-out or a reset.
findings.title: Removal of the legacy session.careerStage key on sign-out and clear has no test
findings.proof: StoredSessionRepositoryTest: write session.careerStage="STUDENT", call signOut() (and clear()), and assert store.read("session.careerStage") is null.
